importBeta.title: Import beta from Instagram
importBeta.intro: Grab the climbs you've already filmed on Instagram and attach them as beta. Run a quick scan in your browser, paste the result, and we'll match each reel to the right climb.

scan.title: Step 1 · Scan your posts
scan.subtitle: This runs in your own browser on Instagram. Nothing leaves your session, and Boardsesh never sees your Instagram login.
scan.step1: Open your Instagram profile in another tab and log in.
scan.step2: Open the browser console (right-click, Inspect, then Console).
scan.step3: Paste the script below and press Enter. On a large account it can take a minute. It logs progress in the console, says how many it found, and copies them to the clipboard.

paste.title: Step 2 · Paste and find
paste.subtitle: Paste what the script copied. We'll read the captions and match them to climbs.
